heading: INT. AEROSTAT BAKERY - UPPER CLOUD DECK OF VENUS - DAY

units.text: INT. AEROSTAT BAKERY - UPPER CLOUD DECK OF VENUS - DAY
A warm, low-ceilinged kitchen suspended in the sulfur haze, its walls lined with copper ovens and rattling racks of dough.
Through a thick quartz porthole, orange clouds roil like boiling custard.
The air smells of yeast and faint lemon.
Every surface is bolted down.
At a floured table kneads MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN, 60s, the head baker, a woman built like a ship's prow, with burn scars freckling her forearms and a gaze that has outlasted three bankruptcies.
Beside her, PIETRO, 19, her apprentice, is piping icing onto a tray of tiny cakes with the care of someone defusing a bomb.
An intercom speaker above the oven door crackles.
Bakery, this is Dispatch. Cloud shear in four minutes. Secure your loose items.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Acknowledged.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: She wipes her hands on her apron.
Pietro glances at the porthole, where the clouds are beginning to churn faster.
A cake slips from the tray and lands on the floor with a quiet splat.
At the back, NOOR, 30s, a pastry cook with flour to her elbows, hauls a tray of buns into the warming rack and does not turn around.
Starboard shutters are down, Madame.
units.name: NOOR

units.text: Madame. The shear is on the starboard side.
units.name: PIETRO

units.text: I can smell it.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: Should we turn off the ovens?
units.name: PIETRO

units.text: We do not turn off the ovens. We turn off the nerves.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: The floor shudders.
Racks rattle.
A cloud of flour lifts from the table and hangs in the air like smoke.
Madame Adebola-Quinn lays a steady hand on a copper oven door.
Pietro takes the icing bag in a white-knuckled grip and keeps piping.
The door at the far end of the kitchen bangs open.
A figure staggers in, a tall woman in a gray inspector's coat dusted with orange pollen, holding a clipboard and a respirator mask in one hand.
This is INSPECTOR LOGANATHAN, 40s, severe, her lenses fogged.
She coughs and waves the mask.
Surprise audit. Nobody move.
units.name: INSPECTOR LOGANATHAN

units.text: We are about to be sheared.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: Then this will be a very memorable audit.
units.name: INSPECTOR LOGANATHAN

units.text: The floor drops half a foot, rises again.
Everything tilts.
Pietro yelps.
A rack of rolls crashes to the floor and scatters across the tile.
The inspector grabs the nearest table and hangs on.
Shear in thirty seconds. All hands, brace.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: I don't want to die in a bakery!
units.name: PIETRO

units.text: You'll die in a very clean bakery.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: That's the first compliment I've noted.
units.name: INSPECTOR LOGANATHAN

units.text: The shear hits.
The whole kitchen lurches, spins a quarter turn on its tether, and settles.
Flour falls like snow.
Then, slowly, the shaking stops.
The orange clouds beyond the porthole begin to calm.
They stand there, three people covered in white, hanging on to a table.
Did we make it?
units.name: PIETRO

units.text: Shear has passed. Carry on.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Carry on.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: She straightens.
Picks a cake off the floor, blows on it, and bites it.
She nods.
Still good.
units.name: MADAME ADEBOLA-QUINN

units.text: The inspector lowers her clipboard.
She takes a cake from the tray, tastes it, and lowers her mask.
Pass.
units.name: INSPECTOR LOGANATHAN
